resolution.note: lane start removes the original task record only after the claim succeeds; lane run kills a session after KRN_LANE_TIMEOUT_MS (default 2h) with a session timeout verdict

title: A failed lane start never loses the task record and a lane session has a timeout
body:
Outcome: krn lane start moves the task record only after the claim succeeds; krn lane run bounds its claude session with a timeout and reports it. Why: src/cli/lane.ts:130-135 carryTaskRecord deletes the original before lane.ts:200-204 removes the worktree on a failed claim; src/cli/lane-run.ts:216-234 spawnSync has no timeout. Proof: tests at that layer (failed claim keeps tasks/<id>.json; a hanging fake claude ends with the timeout verdict). Scope: src/cli/lane.ts, src/cli/lane-run.ts, tests.
Evidence: .krn/runs/qwen-research/report.md (Qwen 4 audit) verified by krn-reader against HEAD 8152cee.
